system.description:
A Giovanni with this Background begins play with one or more spirits (spiriti) already bound to her service. The number and power of these ghostly servants depend on the dots invested: each dot buys one spirit built as a neonate vampire (no additional Disciplines, Backgrounds, or freebie points beyond what follows), starting with a Passion Pool of 5. Every spirit automatically has Auspex 1 and one dot in another common spirit power (see the Discipline equivalents for spirits: Auspex, Chimerstry, Dementation, and low-level Movement of the Mind).

Spending an additional Background dot on a given spirit instead grants it an uncommon power (or a common power at an uncommon level). Spending two additional dots on a spirit grants it a rare level of power.

Example: A character with three dots in Spirit Slaves could have three spirits, each with Auspex 1 and one other common power; or two servants (one weak, one with an uncommon power); or a single servant with either a rare power or two uncommon powers.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
